releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v8.16.0 - Auto-GPU Power Suite & Battery Diagnostics Fix:
- Auto-GPU Hardware Switching Fix: Intercepts WM_POWERBROADCAST (0x0218) AC/Battery kernel interrupts for instant, seamless dGPU sleep/wake.
- Battery Status & Health Fix: Corrected HasBat telemetry population so live battery status, wattage, and wear level display accurately.
- True D3Cold GPU Power Gating: Clean PnP device disabling puts RTX 4060 into true 0.0W sleep on battery, instantly waking to 144Hz on AC charger.
